extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF figure captions and result sections; replaces prior automated placeholder mechanism notes in final artifacts.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: 5 R has source-supported membrane-targeting evidence from computational membrane interaction results and experimental LTA binding/permeability assays; this supports membrane interaction, not a single receptor-specific target.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MD is computational support; direct experimental support is membrane binding/permeability rather than a resolved pore structure.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: 5 R against MRSA NCTC 12493 and S. pyogenes DCCOPD19B
mechanism_claims.claim_text: 5 R perturbs membrane fluidity and proton-motive-force components in the tested Gram-positive bacteria, with assays covering membrane fluidity, membrane depolarisation, intracellular pH, ATP, respiration, and ROS.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper frames PMF disruption as associated with membrane perturbation; it should not be normalized into a single exclusive molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: 5 R has source-supported antibiofilm activity against MRSA and S. pyogenes models, including biofilm formation/mature biofilm assays and in vivo implant-associated biofilm evidence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm endpoint values that exist only as figure/database exact values are preserved as database cautions rather than treated as fully table-verified mechanism quantification.
